doc.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks Smith and wishes him luck.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I want to thank you for sharing your time with us today.

And I hope you have a productive set tonight. I know you have to go and do your little talk-through rehearsal. And it’s been a pleasure. Best of luck in your new environment down in the home of jazz. I hope to see you again.
